lessons_used: Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high (except round 11), while negative predictions were too low as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

candidates.title: Path Selection Checklist Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into a clear checklist layout highlighting key benefits of adoption paths.
candidates.why: Choose path step takes a long mean time (514s), showing users need a clearer structure to decide quickly.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Choose quick adoption or create a custom pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path screen into a checklist layout while maintaining both path options and core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strong historical evidence (+4.3%) for choose_path redesigns, though the step loses relatively few users.

candidates.title: Adoption Customization Preview Stage
candidates.change: Insert a new adoption preview screen showing visual generation progress before final certificate confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% with 1017s mean time and users report pet generation issues.

new_adoption_preview.headline: Preparing Your Desktop Companion
new_adoption_preview.body: We are assembling your pet's desktop assets.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new onboarding preview screen without removing or skipping any required steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop step supported by funnel and mail data, but adoption new screen changes historically show minimal lift (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Sign In Account Continuity List Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in layout into a list format that emphasizes restoring existing pet data.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Log in with your existing account to ensure your pet data and progress are saved.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen into a list format while preserving the account sign-in functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails, but sign-in redesigns have historically shown slight negative lift (-0.1%).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Tip Carousel Flow
candidates.change: Add an automated tip carousel flow on the waiting screen to keep users engaged during generation.
candidates.why: Waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) causing high user drop-off.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Your Pet
waiting.body: Your pet will appear on your desktop shortly.

guard.reason: Adds a tip carousel on the waiting screen while retaining the generation status notification.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait times (2336s), but new flow additions require release and lack positive historical evidence.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Restoration Hint
candidates.change: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to use their original login method.
candidates.why: Support data shows 8 users lost or reset their pets by creating duplicate accounts during sign in.

sign_in.hint: Use your primary account to automatically sync and restore saved pets.

guard.reason: Asks for specific personal account information (primary account)

candidates.title: Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add a hint on the photo upload screen explaining photo framing and lighting guidelines.
candidates.why: 3 support messages cited custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, well-lit photos with centered subjects for best rendering.

guard.reason: Adds framing and lighting advice to the photo upload screen without altering steps or pricing.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop step (60.9%) supported by emails with low-cost guidance hint.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Completion Progress Notification
candidates.change: Enable visual progress tracking and finish notifications on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait time averages 2336s, leading to drop-off without clear progress indicators.

guard.reason: Enables progress tracking and notifications on the waiting screen while maintaining its job.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 2336s wait drop-off; home changes have shown positive trend (+1.6%).

candidates.title: Home Intro Controls Overview Split Layout
candidates.change: Switch the home intro screen layout to split view detailing taskbar tray management.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to hide, show, or control the pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready
home_intro.body: Access pet controls anytime from your system tray or taskbar icon.

guard.reason: Changes home intro screen layout to split view detailing taskbar tray controls within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: High drop step and mail evidence, but finish layout redesigns historically showed negative lift (-1.0%).

candidates.title: Home Intro System Tray Instructions Copy
candidates.change: Update home intro screen copy with step-by-step instructions for interacting with desktop pets.
candidates.why: Users wrote to support asking how to control or hide the pet once onboarding finishes.

home_intro.headline: Pet Installed Successfully
home_intro.body: Click the taskbar pet icon to open controls, toggle desktop visibility, or talk to your pet.

guard.reason: Updates copy on the home intro screen providing clear controls instructions without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: High impact and support mail evidence solved cheaply via copy without layout risks.

candidates.title: Story Screen Path Overview Copy Update
candidates.change: Revise story screen text to set clear expectations between standard pets and custom photo pets.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s, indicating confusion between available onboarding paths.

story.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Learn how desktop pets work and choose between pre-made companions or custom creations.

guard.reason: Updates story screen text to introduce the desktop pets and set expectations while preserving core job.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text tweak on choose_path, which has responded positively to clarity changes.
